# Pin Root Fillet

Pins under 5 mm across with no fillet where they meet the part.

<figure markdown="span">
![Pin Root Fillet: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/pin-root-fillet-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Pin Root Fillet: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/pin-root-fillet-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>A fillet where a thin pin meets the part, where it would snap.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Warning | Published, [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-fdm "Pins under 5 mm need a small fillet at the base"), [FacFox](../../citations/bibliography.md#facfox-fdm) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Warning | Published, [Prototek](../../citations/bibliography.md#prototek-sla "Thin walls should have filleted bases") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Warning | Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "Fillet thin features where they meet the part") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner. Printed pins snap at their base, where stress gathers on a layer line. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner. Printed pins snap at their base, where stress gathers on a layer line. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner, where it snaps when the supports come off or in use. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner, where it snaps when the supports come off or in use. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner, where it snaps when the powder is blasted off. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin with a sharp base: `{feature}` (`{size}`) meets the part at a sharp corner, where it snaps when the powder is blasted off. Add a small fillet where it meets the part.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
